rule: Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium). | Generic/template type arguments are dropped from every ID (`HashSet#<init>`).
notes: Receivers typed by: parameter (first), local declaration (local), `var = new T()` (made), foreach variable (it), pattern binding (matched), an obj.field chain whose field has a declared type (holder.Current, Current is a field of type Item), a parameter of an external generic type (items: List, type argument dropped, medium) and a catch parameter (ex: written fully qualified, medium). The Worker constructor only assigns a field; `o is Item matched` is a pattern, not a call.
